pending_commit.commit_message: tast: Build and push files at one place. Previously, local test bundles, remote test bundles and local test runner were built and pushed separately, which was wasting some time. This change moves all logic about building and pushing files to the beginning of run.Run and utilizes parallel Go build for speed up. vpd: Add '--raw' for parsing raw VPD contents The VPD kernel driver does not export key names with dot but we use it for manufacturing stage, where the userland 'vpd' can read and write. However, to parse boot time values efficiently, factory software startup will try to fetch these special values using kernel driver and fail to read correct values. As a result, we want the VPD userland driver being able to read the raw blob exported from VPD kernel driver, the 'ro_raw' and 'rw_raw' files. A new --raw is now introduced so the `vpd` utility can read a VPD key-value store without VPD headers, just like what the kernel driver provides. BUG=b:135048597 TEST=vpd -l --raw /sys/firmware/vpd/ro_raw BRANCH=none Change-Id: I83415e966ccf6ab878cc48a407ac20da99a9aa87 Signed-off-by: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1686805 Commit-Ready: Fei Shao <fshao@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Wei-Han Chen <stimim@chromium.org>

cryptohome: CheckKeyEx support for chall-resp keys Add support of the challenge-response keys (a.k.a. smart card login keys) into the CheckKeyEx operation. This allows to implement unlocking at the Lock Screen for the users who log into smart cards. Performance note: Currently, for the sake of simplicity, the implementation follows full procedure needed for the decryption of the smart card user's vault keyset. This can be optimized in the future, when the ChallengeCredentialsHelper::Verify() operation is implemented, since this implementation will need only one challenge (versus the currently needed two challenges) and won't do round-trip through the TPM chip. BUG=chromium:842791 TEST=manual, add CheckKeyEx calls into the ChallengeResponseMount Tast test Change-Id: Ifa7564088e1cfd89bc0f6fc9b625c334c91a70e0 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1678661 Tested-by: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Ryo Hashimoto <hashimoto@chromium.org>
